# Expense Policy

## Travel

Hotel stays are reimbursed up to 180 dollars per night. Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 65 dollars per day. Receipts are mandatory for any single expense above 25 dollars.

## Submitting

Submit expense reports in the Ledgerly tool within 45 days of the purchase date. Reports submitted later need approval from a finance director.
